note: Independent re-judgment on 2026-11-25 against RFC 6793 Section 4.1 ('The new attributes, AS4_PATH and AS4_AGGREGATOR, MUST NOT be carried in an UPDATE message between NEW BGP speakers.'). Reviewed all diffs since the prior verdict across rfc6793-no-as4path-from-new-speaker.ci and rfc6793-no-as4aggregator-from-new-speaker.ci (bus endpoint migration only; exact send frames and exact receiver wire hex expectations without AS4_PATH/AS4_AGGREGATOR are unchanged) and rfc6793-narrow-to-old-speaker.ci (bus/bgp-rib migration with static 1.1.1.1/32 -> lo, option=needs-linux, receiver-old local 127.0.0.12, and comment wording in 1f82b2727d). Verified conn=2's exact expected wire hex in rfc6793-narrow-to-old-speaker.ci byte-for-byte: 66 octets carrying ORIGIN(IGP), 2-octet AS_PATH([65000,65001,AS_TRANS]), NEXT_HOP(127.0.0.12), AS4_PATH([65000,65001,4200000123]), and NLRI(10.0.0.0/24), proving the MUST NOT is scoped to NEW-to-NEW sessions and not a blanket drop. Both Go origination unit tests are unchanged. Enforcement is unchanged.
